title: Late-Increase Room Nights in Group Room Blocks Cancellation Damages
content:
**Rider.** On a Group Room Blocks cancellation the late-increase part of the chargeable room nights is the contracted room nights the block's increase entries added to the contract, which are the contracted room nights less the room nights of the allocation entry plus the room nights of the reduction entries, never below zero and never more than the chargeable room nights left after the room nights of the block's cut-off release entries are set apart. The late-increase part counts at the late-increase share, which follows when the block's latest increase entry was posted:

- when the increases added room nights to the contract and the latest increase entry is dated **after the cut-off date**, the share is **0.5**;
- when they added room nights and the latest increase entry is dated **on the cut-off date or no more than 30 calendar days before it**, the share is **0.75**;
- in every other case the share is one.

Chargeable room nights outside the late-increase part are not weighted by this share.

### Worked shares (hypothetical block: allocation entry 200, reduction entries 10, contracted room nights 220, so the increases added 30)

| Latest increase entry dated | Late-increase share | The 30 added room nights count as |
|---|---|---|
| 5 days after the cut-off date | 0.5 | 15 |
| on the cut-off date | 0.75 | 22.5 |
| 30 days before the cut-off date | 0.75 | 22.5 |
| 31 days before the cut-off date | one | 30 |

A block contracted at 190 room nights against an allocation entry of 200 and reduction entries of 10 shows 190 less 200 plus 10, that is 0 added room nights, and carries no late-increase part.
